facts: Sabey planned a 30 MW power contract with the Douglas County PUD over 11 years, making it the county's largest customer
A $100 million data center was to be built on a 30-acre plot in East Wenatchee over 18 months
Microsoft began construction on a 74-acre server farm in Quincy in April 2006
The Sabey facility was expected to generate only 30 to 50 jobs
